stem: Why was this 1803 event significant to the U.S. government?

options.label: A
options.text: It contributed to the formation of the first political parties.

options.label: B
options.text: It improved diplomatic relations with Mexico.

options.label: C
options.text: It led to a new understanding of presidential powers.

options.label: D
options.text: It showed the need to give the Senate the power to approve treaties.

visual_elements:
This list describes an event from early U.S. history.

The Louisiana Purchase of 1803

• Bought from France for $15 million
• Consisted of 530 million acres of land
• Included the port city of New Orleans
